conditions.description: K0 + random macros, matched to D by count and size
human-expert DSL, authored blind to the evolved genomes
A plus all compute D's evolution consumed

declared_outcome_interpretations.efficiency_only: compression improved with capability inside the non-inferiority margin -> reported as an efficiency result, never as a capability result
declared_outcome_interpretations.h0_consistent: any of F, H, I matches or beats the treatment, or the concentration test fails with shortcut-shaped primitives -> recorded as consistent with H0 regardless of the aggregate effect size
declared_outcome_interpretations.null_result: effect below threshold -> recorded in docs/research/negative_results/ with the search-space constraint it implies
declared_outcome_interpretations.positive: primary effect met, FDR-corrected, all control gates passed, concentration test passed -> would proceed to S4 in a model-based experiment; here it licenses only the statement that the instrument can detect an effect of this size

exclusion_criteria: Exclusion for unfavourable results is prohibited; all exclusions listed with cause.

minimum_interesting_effect.note: Spec §24.8's provisional >=5 percentage-point threshold, retained rather than relaxed. E0 measured variance 0.005064 implies 32 seeds are required to power it; the seed count was raised to 32 rather than weakening the threshold to suit the budget.

model_identity.claim_limitation: ADR-0007: results are Claim Level 0/E instrument validation and cannot bear on H2, H13, H14 or H15, all of which are claims about a model.
model_identity.kind: deterministic enumerative synthesizer, NOT a language model

primary_endpoint: verified_ood_solve_rate_per_compute on held-out compositional families F9-F12
stopping_rule: Fixed: 32 seeds per condition, all conditions run to completion. No interim analysis, no data-dependent stopping. Aborted runs are recorded with their cause, never silently discarded.
